current_flow: budget-loader adds POST /api/ingest/budget as a second method on the existing IngestController/IngestService (same 'ingest' grant, allow-list, multipart pattern, and a jszip guard extracted to a shared workbook-guard.ts): the MIS Table-2 sheet is found by its required header set, every date-headed month block present is read (exact 'Budget' / 'Roll Over Budget' sub-columns; YTD/FY and Actual/% ignored), GL line rows become mis_budget rows with every field as provided at paise (formula cells only via cached results), the whole workbook is preflight-validated, and the service replaces each present period through the REUSED IngestionRepository.replaceBudgetBatch inside ONE outer transaction with proven rollback, retaining each period's prior batch. Isolation is PoC-scoped to (budget, period). sap_transaction is never touched (0004). No new module, grant, migration, dependency, or warehouse change.
new_abstractions: the shared workbook-guard.ts (jszip pre-materialization guard used by both parsers)
the MIS Table-2 header-identified budget parser (date-headed month blocks, cached-formula semantics, preflight)
the ingestBudget service method (one outer transaction wrapping per-period replaceBudgetBatch)
IngestBudgetResponse with an explicit per-period association

criteria_map.POST /api/ingest/budget uses the same Au: KEEP. criteria_map.the MIS format workbook loads into mis_b: KEEP (amended). mis_budget rows are emitted per GL line row x each DATE-headed month block present, every field as provided (format_id constant, line_id = S.No, gl_code, cost_center = the MIS Budget Components label, budget = 'Budget', rollover = the real 'Roll Over Budget' column) at paise; formula cells accepted only via cached numeric results (uncached = diagnostic, never 0.00); YTD/FY blocks and Actual/% ignored; sap_transaction never read, written or joined (0004) (findings 2, 3, 4, 10).
criteria_map.a budget upload replaces only its (forma: KEEP (amended, human-decided). Isolation is PoC-scoped to the shipped active key (source_kind='budget', period) - one nursery format + one plant DUB make that the effective key; format_id/plant are row/metadata attributes; multi-format/multi-plant isolation is deferred with a revisit trigger. A re-upload replaces each present period atomically inside ONE outer transaction (new IngestionRepository(transaction), the proveWarehouse pattern) with a proven rollback on a later-period failure; each period's prior batch is retained; whole-workbook preflight (dup grain, missing S.No/component, zero GL rows, uncached amounts) rejects before any write; the D-0008 host command is pinned (findings 1, 5, 6, 7).

gaps: The replacement key promised by criterion 3 (format/period/canonical plant) is impossible in scope: ingest_batch and replaceBatch key only on (source_kind, period); neither format nor plant is durable or used in the active-batch switch, so a second plant/format would replace the first

The source header disagrees with the parser contract: the workbook's monthly rollover column is 'Roll Over Budget' while the task required 'Roll Over', so exact matching would omit or reject rollover values
Workbook cardinality was contradictory: the parser/service promised exactly twelve month blocks and twelve replacements while manual verification required a successful two-month fixture

Formula semantics were unspecified: the rollover cells are formulas with cached results, and reusing the actuals helper would turn a missing formula cache into null, which the money parser treats as blank/0.00 - silent financial corruption

Cross-period atomicity was asserted, not designed or proved: each replaceBudgetBatch opens its own transaction and the plan did not state how all periods are wrapped or how rollback on a later failure is proven

Validation missed malformed-but-writeable inputs: no preflight rejection for duplicate budget grain, a GL row missing its S.No/component, or a workbook with no GL rows, which could raise a DB constraint error or activate empty batches
D-0008 had no runnable proof command: verify commands stop at hermetic tests and the DB test skips without WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1, so 'host-run' was narration rather than an executable pinned command
The 'shared jszip guard' had no sharing seam: the only guard is private inside sap-actuals.parser.ts, which was outside this task's write scope, forcing duplication or an undeclared edit
The response shape {batchIds, periods, rowCount} was ambiguous: no batch-to-period association, ordering, or per-period counts
Handover drift: the plan said replaceBudgetBatch comes from warehouse-schema; it is implemented in backend/src/warehouse/ingestion.repository.ts
resolutions: HUMAN-decided: PoC-scope isolation to the shipped active key (source_kind='budget', period) - one nursery MIS format + one plant (DUB) make that the effective key; format_id and plant are row/metadata attributes (plant recorded in validation_result), not part of the switch; multi-format/multi-plant isolation (a schema-key change) is deferred with a revisit trigger.
Match the sub-columns EXACTLY as the workbook names them, whitespace-normalized: 'Budget', 'Roll Over Budget', 'Actual', '%'.
Handle EVERY date-headed month block present (twelve in the real workbook, two in a fixture) - never assume a count; one budget batch per present period.

Specified cell semantics: numeric cells read directly; a FORMULA cell is accepted ONLY via its cached numeric result (cell.value.result) rounded to paise; a formula with no cached result or an error result is a rows.<n>.<column> diagnostic, never blank/0.00; a genuinely blank cell is '0.00'.

Specified the mechanism: the service opens ONE outer db.transaction, constructs new IngestionRepository(transaction) (the repository accepts a transaction as its db exactly as proveWarehouse does), and calls replaceBudgetBatch once per period inside it (nested savepoints); the service test proves a later-period failure rolls back earlier ones with a mocked repository, and the gated DB leaf proves it live.

Added preflight rejections before ANY write, each a rows.<n>.<column> 400: duplicate (format_id, period, line_id, gl_code, cost_center) grain within the upload; a GL line row missing its S.No or Budget Components; a workbook with zero GL line rows; any non-numeric or uncached amount.

Pinned the exact executable D-0008 host command in the contract, the plan and tests.json (WAREHOUSE_PG_* + PGHOST/PGPORT + WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1 node --test backend/src/ingest/ingest.service.test.ts) for the gated leaf, run by the orchestrator.

Extracted the jszip pre-materialization guard into a NEW backend/src/ingest/workbook-guard.ts (write_scope +) used by BOTH parsers; sap-actuals.parser.ts added to write_scope ONLY to import the shared guard - one implementation, no duplicated security logic.
Made the response explicit: IngestBudgetResponse = { formatId, plant, periods: Array<{ period, batchId, rowCount }>, totalRowCount } - a per-period association, never parallel arrays.
Corrected the plan: replaceBudgetBatch is implemented in backend/src/warehouse/ingestion.repository.ts (warehouse-schema is the task that built it).

summary: One cold read returned ten findings. Nine are repository/decision-answerable and resolved in the amended contract + plan (the real 'Roll Over Budget' header, every present month block rather than exactly twelve, cached-formula semantics that never silently zero an uncached cell, an explicit one-outer-transaction mechanism with a rollback test, preflight rejections, a pinned D-0008 host command, the jszip guard extracted to a shared workbook-guard.ts, an explicit per-period response, and a wording fix). The one genuine product decision - that criterion 3's (format/period/plant) isolation exceeds the shipped (source_kind, period) key - went to the human, who PoC-scoped it to (budget, period) and deferred multi-plant isolation. Verdict pass.
